nodes.summary:
usage: corvint-web-flows --experimental --trusted-local --manifest FILE --assets DIR [--root DIR] [--observe]
                         [--flows DIR] [--navigation FILE] [--execution FILE] [--fixtures FILE] [--max-effect EFFECT]
Run the experimental web-flows profile over a committed intent manifest; --observe opts into starting the
owned local server and browser.
Example: corvint-web-flows --experimental --trusted-local --manifest flows.json --assets ~/.local/share/corvint/web-flows
--assets: installed tools/web-flows directory
--execution: committed experimental execution input
--experimental: enable the proposed experimental profile
--fixtures: private fixture ID to value JSON
--flows: committed navigation flows directory
--manifest: tracked relative intent JSON path
--max-effect: independent maximum effect grant
--navigation: native evidence-free navigation packet
--observe: explicitly start owned local server and browser
--root: Git application root
--timeout: execution deadline, at most five minutes
--trusted-local: server and runtime are trusted local code
usage: corvint-web-flows --experimental --trusted-local --manifest FILE --assets DIR [--root DIR] [--observe] [--flows DIR] [--navigation FILE] [--execution FILE] [--fixtures FILE] [--max-effect EFFECT] [--timeout VALUE]
